SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date = '2001-09-25'
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-25 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-09-26 00:00:00';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price),0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date > '2025-09-25' AND c.birth_date <= '2026-09-25';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
    AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = substr('2026-09-24', 6, 2)
    AND substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = substr('2026-09-24', 9, 2)
);

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date >= '2001-09-24'
  AND c.birth_date <  '2001-09-25';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-26') AS TEXT) >= c.birth_date
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-26', '+1 year') AS TEXT) <= c.birth_date
     OR (CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-26', '+1 year') AS TEXT) > c.birth_date
          AND CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-26') AS TEXT) < c.birth_date || '-12-31');

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    -- Calculate completed age exactly 25 on 2026-09-26
    -- A person is exactly 25 when their 25th birthday is on or before 2026-09-26
    -- and their 26th birthday is after 2026-09-26
    (c.birth_date <= '2001-09-26' AND c.birth_date > '2000-09-26')
    AND o.date >= '2026-09-26' AND o.date < '2026-09-27';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-12-01
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CAST(SUBSTR('2026-12-01', 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
  ) = 25
  AND
  -- Check that the birthday on 2026-12-01 has already occurred (or is today)
  SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 5) <= '12-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 10000 +
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 +
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
) * 10000 + 25 * 365 + 6 <= CAST('20261201' AS INTEGER) AND
(
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 10000 +
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 +
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
) * 10000 + 26 * 365 + 6 > CAST('20261201' AS INTEGER);
